attempts.name: 剪水啪
attempts.prompt:
Use case: stylized game VFX sprite atlas. Make ONE studio-quality RGBA SPRITE SHEET containing exactly SIX animation cels, arranged in a precise 3 columns by 2 rows grid of equal square cells (landscape 3:2 sheet). Read top-left to top-right, then bottom-left to bottom-right. The center of every cell is the fixed point of impact. Every drawing is isolated on genuinely transparent background with a margin inside its cell. Significant clear gutters between cells, no cross-cell marks. NO labels, letters, borders, digits, grid lines or captions. A short single mobile game bubble impact, a tiny 11px target popping into a larger wet splash. Generous transparent negative space between strong, easy-to-read silhouettes. Glossy, elastic and wet. Color of the water is as important as its highlight. Splash limbs and droplets have little sharp white wet glints, clear colored bodies. Study the supplied game VFX references only for the charming rounded rendering, not the original particle arrangement. Each cel is a temporal successor with consistent trajectories, not 6 independent illustrations, not 6 finished poses of the same size. Only paint the liquid and its moving drops. No floor or cast shadow, no ground puddle, no smoky or white fog mass, no circular shock wave, concentric contours, crescent arcs around the impact or even halo of particles. No solid crystal shards, floating fleck confetti, emoji, UI, environment or stars replacing the water.
Concept direction and required action: A clean two-beat asymmetric hydraulic snap: one forked liquid jet lashes obliquely up-right, a shorter side spur splashes down-left. A strongly directional calligraphic silhouette, tapered water fingers and trailing pearl droplets. Color it in a single saturated clear cyan/azure body with discrete small CLEAN WHITE specular glints, no secondary hue so it can be exported as a neutral tint mask plus a white highlight layer. Keep the material translucent-looking but the shape readable. Six beats: 1 small intact cyan soap bubble with white glint centered and lots of empty room. 2 short diagonal membrane pinch and first jet opening. 3 explosive hero pose: long forked wet jet up-right, small opposing jet down-left, detached pear-shaped drops leaving the tips, no solid blob in center. 4 jet separates into two longer and two shorter elongated water drops shooting farther out along SAME diagonal, beautiful gaps. 5 the same drops farther apart, visibly smaller and thinner. 6 just three tiny fading liquid pinpricks on this diagonal, no remnant at center. Single impact point fixed, action opposite corners.

Concept direction and required action: A physical squash-and-rebound water balloon made of warm tangerine-orange liquid. The distinctive signature is an exaggerated squash flat THEN a tall springy reverse splash with fat floppy wet tips, like popping a water balloon. Playful 2.5D soft candy bubble world. Draw thick ribbons of orange translucent liquid, juicy specular highlights, do not depict a solid jelly candy, slime character or floor splash pool. Six precise cels: 1 a small round orange soap balloon, centered. 2 still intact VERY wide extremely low flat oblate orange oval; elastic pinched waist dimples, glossy white highlight flattened across it. 3 BIG overshoot: tall central fountain tongue flipping up asymmetrically and two stubby floppy liquid wings sideways, three fat droplets shoot off, center begins to tear open. 4 empty impact point; the fountain folds into two ascending arched thick gobs and three separate lateral stretched drops. 5 round but non-uniform smaller water drops losing upward momentum and curling down at the ends, a few tiny satellites, not evenly distributed. 6 just two or three tiny ORANGE descending beads catching a highlight, widely spaced. Obvious play of width to height, mass to emptiness; distinct from a diagonal slash.

Concept direction and required action: A chain within one bubble pop. The mother bubble pinches apart into THREE recognizable translucent miniature SOAP BUBBLES with lively unequal trajectories like a little skipping-stone family; then they burst one-by-one into tiny WATER FANS, not rings. Saturated sapphire / pool-blue thin soap skins, clear transparent centers, tiny upper-left white glints, soft cyan on the liquid tips. Six cels: 1 a small intact glossy blue parent sphere at center. 2 parent deforms into a connected three-lobed trilobed droplet pinched by thin wet necks. 3 three distinct unequal baby soap bubbles have separated: largest slightly up-left of center, medium high-right, smallest low-right; small thin liquid tails behind them, broad empty negative space between. 4 LARGEST has popped into a little lopsided three-finger splash and two drops up-left; medium moves a little further up-right and small still moves down-right. 5 medium bursts into a 3-tip sharp mini water fan at upper right and small one starts breaking below-right, a few tiny droplets remain where first burst. 6 only the final tiny blue drop fan below-right and several widely spaced tiny pinpricks at the earlier positions. Each of these SIX cels is part of one quick readable staccato sequence. Big baby bubble dimensions approximately 22% of cell at maximum, the others smaller. No constellation of evenly spaced beads, circular garland, fog or bubbles around perimeter.

Concept direction and required action: Bold hand-inked arcade comic water accent, visibly flatter/more graphic than the other concept directions, bright honey-orange liquid flat-filled bold wedge and paddle shapes offset by a small deep tangerine edge on the shadow side, crisp creamy white painted streaks INSIDE the colored liquid. Aim for a satisfying printed onomatopoeia WITHOUT ANY words, stars, lettering or impact symbols. The signature silhouette is a LOPSIDED FAN of three fat teardrop paddle strokes and short side splats angled upwards; sharply tapered roots and very round bulb ends. No radial sun, spikes in all directions, ring, white flash or cloudy fill. Six beats: 1 a small graphic round orange bubble with a single tilted white lozenge glint. 2 an angular squash, like a sharp hand-drawn impact smear rising from the hit point. 3 full heroic fan, three SEPARATE graphic swooshes of liquid from a low common root upwards (left stroke longest, center fat and short, right curls out), with 2 flat drop accents and large transparent gaps between fan fingers. 4 fan flicks apart into five separated thick leaf-shaped liquid paddles and a small droplet already further from center along same trajectories. 5 five much smaller, farther out blunt-ended little liquid dashes with interrupted streaks. 6 just two very small orange print-like water dabs. Keep frames recognizable as wet pop, thick clean contour and simple graphic color grouping, no minute detail. No black enclosing burst panel, no floor splat.

art_export: One generated six-cel sheet per concept. Isolated, registered, rescaled and alpha-cleaned into horizontal strips. Detached late droplets were resized about their own centers for follow-through. A uses a grayscale diffuse layer and independent white gloss. B-D retain their authored example palette in the strip; presentation hue follows each hit in the board preview.
